# Membridge conformance vectors

`v1.json` is mirrored byte-exactly from upstream. MEM-03 (konareef#26)
re-mirrored it on 2026-09-24 from paygate-zk main `ecd6232`, after the
2026-06-10 Poseidon hash swap (konareef-rinit/v1 spec D6):

    paygate-zk/docs/prds/konareef-integration-contract-conformance-vectors-v1.json

Regenerated by:

    python3 paygate-zk/scripts/gen_prd4_memory_vectors.py

Sync rule: a CI job MUST `diff --exit-code` this file against the
upstream copy. Any byte difference fails the build. To update, refresh
upstream first (separate paygate-zk MR), then re-mirror here.

`capture_provisional_v1.json` is konareef-local. It keeps the two capture
provisional-id vectors that the pre-swap upstream file carried and the
current one does not. Only their provisional_id, logical_key and index
fields are checked; their value and leaf hashes are the stale SHA-256
values (see the file's description).
